project.name: KHKD - Dicrocoelium
project.description: Vietnamese science-horror Reel — san bien kien thanh zombie leo ngon co
project.story: Dicrocoelium dendriticum is a lancet liver fluke. Adults live in livers of grazing animals like cows. Eggs come out in feces, snails eat them, snails cough up slime balls containing larvae, ants eat the slime. One larva migrates to the ant's sub-esophageal ganglion (brain) and hijacks behavior. Every night the infected ant leaves the colony, climbs to the tip of a grass blade, and clamps its jaws there, waiting motionless to be eaten by a grazing animal. If it survives the night, the parasite releases control by morning so the ant returns to safety. Every night the cycle repeats — until one day the ant is eaten, completing the parasite's life cycle.
